events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – an album and a song that still resonate globally. What does this timeless anthem mean to you?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Born Gordon Sumner, the legendary musician Sting celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to Sting! From The Police to his solo career, his music has spanned decades and genres. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music as we knew it.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today marks 25 years since the original iPod changed how we listened to music. Did you have one of the early models?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day commemorates the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007. What's your all-time favourite Bond film, gadget, or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles member and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese's Comedy Legacy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. Which track from this iconic record is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, showmanship, and legacy remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles pushed boundaries with 'Rubber Soul'. It marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy Lives On
angles.copy: On this poignant day, we remember John Lennon. His artistry and his message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Iconic musician and artist David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Celebrating David Bowie
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius of David Bowie. A true chameleon of music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the legendary Elvis Presley. His impact on music and culture is truly unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs defined a generation. What's your favourite piece of his guitar wizardry?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop legend Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! His distinctive voice has given us countless hits.

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! The voice behind so many classic tracks. What's your favourite Madness singalong?
